name: How do I choose the best layout for a small kitchen?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the best layout for a small kitchen?

acceptedAnswer.text: For a small kitchen, maximizing efficiency and creating an illusion of space are key. U-shaped or L-shaped layouts can optimize counter space and storage, while a galley kitchen (two parallel walls) is efficient for narrow spaces. Consider compact appliances, vertical storage solutions, and light-colored materials to make the room feel larger. Integrating dining areas with islands or peninsulas can add functionality without sacrificing flow. Careful planning helps ensure every inch serves a purpose.
acceptedAnswer.description: For small kitchens, U-shaped, L-shaped, or galley layouts maximize space. Focus on compact appliances, vertical storage, and light colors to enhance efficiency and openness.
